Your Personal AI Tutor
That Grows With You

Saarthi (सारथि) means {" "}guide in Sanskrit. It is an AI tutor that remembers your doubts, sessions, and progress, so every study session starts from where you actually are.

Speak or type your questions, learn with an interactive avatar, and resume any session later with full context. Saarthi is a long-term learning companion, not just a one-off answer bot.

No credit card required • Free to start • Built for students

{/* SECTION: What exactly is Saarthi? */}

What is Saarthi?

Saarthi is an AI-powered tutor that runs in your browser. You start a session with a subject-specific AI tutor, talk to it like you would talk to a real teacher, and Saarthi keeps a memory of what you covered.

It is not just a chat box. It is a combination of:

  • A subject-aware AI tutor (Omkar for AI & ML, Priya for Biology)
  • Voice + 3D avatar interface for natural, explanation-first teaching
  • Persistent sessions, so your learning history is never lost

In one line:

Saarthi is a memory-aware AI tutor that guides you through concepts over multiple sessions, instead of answering and forgetting.

What you can do with it:

  • • Prepare for exams topic by topic
  • • Revisit past sessions and continue learning
  • • Ask follow-up questions anytime
{/* SECTION: How Saarthi works (step-by-step) */}

How Saarthi Fits Into Your Study Routine

Think of it as a tutor you can open anytime, pick up where you left off, and ask anything without feeling judged.

1. Pick your tutor

Choose Omkar for AI & ML or Priya for Biology. Each tutor is designed around that subject’s typical doubts and explanations.

2. Learn through conversation

Start a video session, speak or type your questions, and get step-by-step explanations from a 3D avatar with voice responses.

3. Resume any time

Sessions are stored. From your dashboard, you can resume an old session and Saarthi will remember what you were working on.

{/* SECTION: Tutors – improved, more serious */}

Meet the Current AI Tutors

Saarthi will grow over time, but today you can already learn with two focused AI tutors.

{/* Omkar */}

Omkar — AI & Machine Learning

Ideal if you are learning machine learning, neural networks, or trying to understand modern AI systems. Omkar explains technical topics like a senior engineer: clear, structured, and practical.

Supervised & Unsupervised Learning Neural Networks Practical Intuition
{/* Priya */}

Priya — Biology

Designed for students who want to understand biology beyond rote memorization. Priya focuses on diagrams, processes, and “why it works this way” explanations.

Cell Biology Genetics Systems & Processes
{/* MANIFESTO */}

Why Saarthi Exists

Education is not a race. It is a journey of understanding.

Saarthi exists to give every student a personal guide — someone who listens, adapts, and stays with them across multiple study sessions.

Not a chatbot. Not a search tool.

A companion for learning.
